original_ega_i.title: Elements de geometrie algebrique I. Le langage des schemas
original_ega_i.visual_method: pdftoppm at 150 dpi; both complete relevant pages inspected as PNGs, with formulas and page boundaries checked against the exact pinned transcription in SOURCE_PREPARATION. OCR text used only for location assistance.

unit_binding.verified: Integral X; arbitrary O_X-module F; canonical rationalization, kernel T, conditional quasi-coherence of T, and torsion-free quotient.
Quasi-coherent torsion-free F embeds in a rational-function direct sum indexed by I and generates it over R(X); cardinal-rank paragraph is included.
Rank-one forward statement and the converse phrase occur exactly as described by the preflight. This receipt does not reclassify the converse qualification as a novel error.

Statement names only integral X and torsion-free L,L'; it does not name quasi-coherence or rank one. Its proof identifies L_x,L'_x with O_x-submodules of the field O_x and then invokes 7.3.5 to detect zero sections.
unit_binding.formula_verified: f tensor f' = 0 iff f = 0 or f' = 0

unit_binding.verified: Statement on page 163 assumes integral X,Y, dominant f and qc torsion-free source F. Complete proof on page 164 uses left exactness and the simple-sheaf reduction. No claim of quasi-coherence of f_*F appears.
Integral X and quasi-coherent finite-type F; three conditions torsion, zero generic stalk, and support unequal to X; complete closed-support proof present.

The original extends the definitions to reduced X with finitely many components and asserts the equivalence between (a) and (c) from 7.4.6. The support condition being reused is merely Supp(F) unequal to X, not a nowhere-dense condition.

errata_list_2.primary_volume: EGA III. Etude cohomologique des faisceaux coherents, Seconde partie, Liste 2
errata_list_2.inspection: Complete Liste 2 visually read on physical PDF pages 84-90, corresponding to article pages 85-91 and printed footers 217-223. This includes all typographical entries and all numbered text modifications 1-30. No correction of I.7.4.4 is present in this inspected list.

correction.support_short_quote: ne contient aucune composante irreductible de X
correction.quote_normalization: The support excerpt is ASCII accent-normalized; the page image is the exact typographical authority.
correction.full_mathematical_content_paraphrase: The definitions of 7.4.1 are extended, by abuse of language, to reduced preschemes such that each point has an open neighbourhood with finitely many irreducible components. From 7.3.4 and 7.4.6, for a quasi-coherent O_X-module F of finite type, being a torsion sheaf is equivalent to the support containing no irreducible component of X.
differences_from_superseded_text: Global finiteness of irreducible components is replaced by the stated local finiteness condition.
Quasi-coherence and finite type of F are stated explicitly.
The merely proper-support claim is replaced by exclusion of every irreducible component from the support.
correction.authority_consequence: The corrected later printing governs any future adoption of I.7.4.7; the old French and English transcriptions are superseded for this assertion. The mathematical preflight's finite-component comparison agrees with this known correction, but the correction also has the broader local-finiteness scope.

outcome.original_assertions: All seven units and their proofs/rank discussion were visually bound to printed EGA I pages 163-164. The pinned transcriptions preserve the material wording of the original assertions at issue.
outcome.I.7.4.4: The original printed statement omits quasi-coherence and its proof makes the one-dimensional generic-fibre identification noted by the mathematical preflight. No correction to I.7.4.4 was found in the precisely scoped errata checks recorded below. This is not a claim that no correction exists elsewhere or in later revised editions.
outcome.I.7.4.7: Explicitly superseded by EGA III second part, Liste 2, Err_III 12, printed page 88, PDF physical page 87. This is a known printed erratum, not a novel correction.
outcome.corrected_747_scope: Reduced X such that every point has an open neighbourhood with finitely many irreducible components; for a quasi-coherent O_X-module F of finite type, F is torsion if and only if its support contains no irreducible component of X.
outcome.later_definition_alignment: EGA IV fourth part, Liste 3, Err_IV 49, printed page 358, adds a comparison of the torsion-free definition in IV 20.1.5 with I 7.4.1 for reduced X with finitely many irreducible components. It does not restore the superseded proper-support claim of I 7.4.7.
